name: Birthday candles
summary: A friend's birthday story becomes a cake with one candle per year; each friend lights a candle with a one-line wish that floats over the cake, and the birthday person swipes to blow them out into a count of wishes and people.
useWhen: maya's 21st is today, put something on her story friends can do
birthday story where everyone leaves a wish
make a cake people light candles on for calvin turning 22
bday wishes thing for her story, not just a card
lowkey want everyone to wish arun happy birthday in one place
dontUseWhen: collecting money for a gift (use gift-pool or bday-pool)
a recap video of the birthday (use bday-montage)
planning the party itself (use host-board or potluck)

author.description: Whose birthday it is and whose story this is

age.description: How old they turn; the cake gets this many candles, 1 to 40

ago.description: How long ago the story went up, e.g. '11h'

caption.description: Big text on the story, e.g. '21 today'

wishes.description: Wishes already made, oldest first, each lighting one candle; a name may appear up to three times
